title: Install / doctor / upgrade / offboard (docs/bootstrap.md Q2-Q8): a verified local bundle installs through doctor, dry-run and self-test; doctor fix, ownership and tool drift; checksum, pin, edited and tracked targets refused with the install untouched; an upgrade waits for the busy pass, applies from the verified bundle and rolls back; uninstall keeps unlanded work, then archives state; a reinstalled crew reloads each role, coordinator last

steps.name: stage
steps.run:
mkdir -p {state_dir}/a20/home {state_dir}/a20/inst {state_dir}/a20/pack && cd {state_dir}/a20 && for v in 9.9.8 9.9.9; do python3 {source}/scripts/release-bundle.py $v --out mirror/v$v --root {source} --repo campaign/eng-crew || exit 1; done; sed "s|@STATE@|{state_dir}|g; s|@RUN@|{run_id}|g" {source}/dev/tests/scripts/fixtures/campaign/a20/profile.toml > pack/profile.toml && sed '/^name = "github"/a\
mdstack_version = "v9.9.8"
' {source}/dev/tests/scripts/fixtures/campaign/a01/pack/manifest.toml > pack/manifest.toml && sh {source}/dev/tests/scripts/fixtures/campaign/a20/forge.sh {source} {state_dir} campaign/sandbox-{run_id} sbx && grep mdstack_version pack/manifest.toml

steps.name: readme-install-verified-bundle
steps.run: cd {state_dir}/a20 && export HOME={state_dir}/a20/home && I={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id} R={state_dir}/../repo B=inst/mdstack-9.9.8/cli/mdstack N=inst/mdstack-9.9.9/cli/mdstack T=crew-campaign-{run_id} P="--project $CREW_PROJECT --org-profile pack/profile.toml" H="--harness claude-code --harness codex"; tag() { python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]));print(d['tag'],d['status'])" $I/install.json; }; snap() { (cd {state_dir}/.. && find state/campaign__sandbox-{run_id} repo -path repo/.git -prune -o -type f -print | sort | xargs shasum 2>/dev/null; ls inst 2>/dev/null) | shasum; }; pin() { sed -i.bak "s/^mdstack_version = .*/mdstack_version = \"$1\"/" pack/manifest.toml; }; (cd mirror/v9.9.8 && shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS) && tar -xzf mirror/v9.9.8/mdstack-9.9.8.tar.gz -C inst && cat inst/mdstack-9.9.8/VERSION && test "$(cat inst/mdstack-9.9.8/VERSION)" = v9.9.8 && ! ls inst/mdstack-9.9.8/scripts/test-*.py 2>/dev/null

steps.name: tracked-target-refused

steps.name: upgrade-applies-from-verified-bundle
